segments.speaker: athena
segments.caption: Athena
segments.delivery: shepherd disguise shifting into radiant woman and affectionate tactical partner

segments.speaker: athena
segments.caption: Cunning, insatiable trickster, even in your own land you will not lay your lies aside! Enough now: I am Athena, daughter of Zeus, and we two are alike, crooked-minded both, you the best of mortals at scheming and I of gods.
segments.delivery: shepherd disguise shifting into radiant woman and affectionate tactical partner

segments.speaker: odysseus
segments.caption: Odysseus
segments.delivery: instantly lying even at home, then challenging the revealed goddess as an equal strategist

segments.speaker: odysseus
segments.caption: Hard goddess, where were you all the salt years since Troy burned? You stood at my shoulder then, and after, I never once saw you on my deck while I suffered. Now you come smiling and tell me this is Ithaca, so swear it is not one more mockery.
segments.delivery: instantly lying even at home, then challenging the revealed goddess as an equal strategist

segments.speaker: odysseus
segments.caption: So that is the shape of it. Poseidon's wrath made open rescue too costly, and you wore silence the way I wear rags. You hid me even from my own eyes to keep me breathing.
segments.delivery: instantly lying even at home, then challenging the revealed goddess as an equal strategist
